title: DISH Network Reports First Quarter 2019 Financial Results
主要内容: DISH Network Corporation (NASDAQ: DISH) reported revenue of $3.19 billion for the first quarter ending March 31, 2019, down from $3.46 billion in the same period in 2018. Net income was $340 million, compared to $368 million in 2018. Diluted earnings per share were $0.65, down from $0.70. The company ended the quarter with 12.063 million total Pay-TV subscribers, including 9.639 million DISH TV and 2.424 million Sling TV subscribers. Net pay-TV subscribers declined by approximately 259,000, compared to a decline of 94,000 in the first quarter of 2018.
